verdict.rationale: Open-sourcing is a fair question for a government agency's digital filing services, since public-sector software can be released under open licenses, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only two probes recording Akamai 403 denials at www.ftb.ca.gov/robots.txt and webapp.ftb.ca.gov. Neither says anything about published source code or an open license, so there is no evidence the capability exists.
